description: CORE-GAP preregistered output deltas. Every replayed row that differs from the frozen baseline must match exactly one case here; anything else is UNEXPECTED_DELTA and blocks the program.

cases.WS-A:redesignation-edge: subject redesignated old->new locator: the ordinary MODIFY on the OLD key is superseded by a subject_redesignations edge (continuity is an edge, not a relation)
cases.WS-A:dest-side-fld-removal: the new-side locator of a redesignation is a destination declaration, not a subject — the former FALSE_LOCATOR_DECLARATION-class MODIFY on the NEW key is not emitted
cases.WS-A:superseded-binding-journal: BINDING_*/UNBOUND_SUBJECT anomalies attached to superseded relations no longer exist
cases.WS-A:redesignation-refusal: journaled REDESIGNATION_REFUSED for structural 'pasa a ser/denominarse' segments whose destination code cannot be proven (fail-closed abstention)
cases.WS-A:lifecycle-edge-row: lifecycle rows are emitted per relation; superseded relations' rows disappear (the edge row carries its own old_chain_state proof)
cases.WS-A:continuity-edge: a proven CODE_REDESIGNATION emits a subject_redesignations row — new ledger, only NEW_ROWS admissible
cases.WS-B:numero-level: CNMV 'número' is its own level: 'número N' composes numero:N (and 'número N del apartado X)' composes apartado:X.numero:N) instead of colliding into flat apartado:N — same clause, same operation, corrected locator
cases.WS-B:seccion-materialization: an ungoverned standalone 'Sección X'/'Capítulo Y' operative subject emits seccion:N / capitulo:N(.seccion:M); governed 'de la sección' qualifiers still emit nothing
cases.WS-B:subop-content-ownership: a newly resolvable sub-operation (e.g. lettered 'apartado A)') now owns its declared content span; the enclosing clause's after-content no longer over-claims it
cases.WS-B:collision-chain-break: a flat colliding locator that only resolved via an equal-key predecessor loses its CHAIN_PREDECESSOR binding once the predecessors compose under their true declared paths — honest abstention, not fabrication
cases.WS-B:anejo-punto-normalization: a numbered unit ('apartado N'/'número N') directly under an anejo/anexo emits punto:N — the same normalization the flat cascade applied to apartado — so path-composed and flat subjects keep one locator identity
cases.WS-B:nota-miscapture: the CNMV 'nota' declaration required a trailing letter but no word boundary, so 'Notas aclaratorias' captured a phantom nota 'a'; the \b repair drops that false component wherever it appeared
cases.WS-C:declared-anejo-gate: positional anejo fill is a derived address, not a declared identity (PREREG §5 debt flag): an 'anejo:N' minted by the fill no longer feeds image binding — the before side falls back to structural XML candidates or abstains with BINDING_NOT_FOUND/UNBOUND_SUBJECT journaled
cases.WS-C:scope-word-normalization: sub_scope surface words now normalize accents/plurals and the anejo->punto alias, so a clause naming its own locator kinds no longer fails the scope proof — the after-content binding binds (evaluator BINDING_CORRECT) or abstains one gate later with a different honest reason
cases.WS-C:positional-leaf-composition: a declared positional item ('párrafo N'/'guión N') composes as a positional leaf inside a proven parent path — the locator gains its .parrafo:N/.guion:N component; same clause, same operation, corrected locator identity
cases.WS-C:unnumbered-disposition: a 'Norma/Disposición <tipo>' head or clause reference without ordinal emits disp:<tipo> — a declared class identity, uniqueness proven by head enumeration in the target (fail-closed on plurality)
cases.WS-C:old-format-heads: old-format CNMV documents carry operative structure in centro_* display classes: block_head splits sections and context_head updates scope — operations previously invisible now parse, with honest resolutions
cases.WS-C:unkeyed-anonymous-journal: an operative item whose structural kind is named but whose identity cannot be keyed ('los dos guiones', bare 'el anexo') journals UNKEYED_ANONYMOUS_ITEM — accounting without fabrication; NEW_ROWS only
cases.WS-C:positional-anchor-suppression: a captured positional mention that only anchors anonymous items is not emitted as a subject — the op carries subjects=[] plus the unkeyed journal, not a false relation
